rem Almost Right-angled Triangles II
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=224
rem Count the integer triangles with
rem a^2 + b^2 + 1 = c^2, a <= b and
rem perimeter at most Limit

use numbers
use sequences
use io
use cli

option Limit integer = 75000000

rem All solutions hang from (2, 2, 3) in
rem a ternary tree whose three maps keep
rem a^2 + b^2 - c^2. The tree is its own
rem mirror image (a <-> b), so below a
rem triangle with a = b, its own mirror,
rem maps 1 and 3 give mirror subtrees,
rem so only map 1 is walked.
rem Those are taken level by level,
rem dropping the triangles that are too
rem long; their depth is below the root
rem of Limit.
Answer = 0
A = array shape 0 fill 0
B = A
C = A
S = 2
T = 3
for K in 1 to 40
  if 2 * S + T at most Limit
    Answer += 1
    A = concat A (array (2 * T - S))
    B = concat B (array (S + 2 * T))
    C = concat C (array (3 * T))
    Next = 4 * S + 3 * T
    S = 3 * S + 2 * T
    T = Next
  end
end
for Lv in 1 to (Limit isqrt)
  Per' = A + B + C
  Fit = Per at most Limit
  A = A filter Fit array
  B = B filter Fit array
  C = C filter Fit array
  Answer += A len
  Ta = 2 * A
  Tb = 2 * B
  Tc = 2 * C
  Tc3 = Tc + C
  Up = A + Tc
  Dn' = Tc - A
  Wp = B + Tc
  Wm' = Tc - B
  Df = Ta - Tb
  Sm' = Ta + Tb
  A1' = Up - Tb
  A2' = Up + Tb
  A3' = Dn + Tb
  B1' = Ta + Wm
  B2' = Ta + Wp
  B3' = Wp - Ta
  C1' = Tc3 + Df
  C2' = Tc3 + Sm
  C3' = Tc3 - Df
  A = concat A1 A2 A3
  B = concat B1 B2 B3
  C = concat C1 C2 C3
end
Answer print
